correctness.rationale: Exact 39 chartwise characteristic-three reduced Gröbner bases each equal (1), and the geometric base ideal equals (1) on three charts. Independent GF3/GF9/GF27 singular point search passes; the at-most-three extension degree lemma for cubic singularities proves sufficiency. The first-jet map to a 3-dimensional space at any rational point proves the dimension cap.

broader_coverage.reasoning: General smooth-family theorem would dominate this result only if its characteristic hypothesis covered p=3,d=3,n=2; it does not. Geometrically irreducible cubics may be nodal or cuspidal; irreducibility-only conclusions do not imply smoothness. A dimension-three all-smooth net is not supplied by smooth-pencil existence.
